C1324.title: New York Financial Firm Audit Uncovers 65 Unauthorized AI Tools
C1324.summary: VentureBeat’s report on shadow AI cites Prompt Security CEO Itamar Golan and states that unapproved AI applications are spreading in enterprise environments, potentially weakening security, compliance, and data governance. The material provides case background for audit blind spots and sensitive-data leakage risks when regulated industries such as finance use unauthorized AI tools internally.
